article_title: EF Core 10 大列表查询：2098 参数悬崖
core_theme: EF Core 10 的 Contains 默认翻译存在一个位于参数上限之前的性能悬崖：越界不报错，反而换了翻译方式变快
reader_takeaway: 知道 2098 这个真实上限、分桶补齐会让参数多于列表长度，以及越过上限后查询会静默改成单个 JSON 参数
summary_angle: 一支由 ID 组成的队列在默认翻译下越挤越慢，直到撞上 2098 这条边界线；越过边界后道路收窄成一条单参数管道，反而跑得更快

information_blocks.source_anchor: 实测：大约 1,000 到 2,098 个 ID 都落在最慢区间，代码里没有任何信号
information_blocks.visual_idea: 密集的 ID 方块挤成一条拥堵的队伍

information_blocks.source_anchor: EF 用 CalculateParameterBucketSize 对参数列表分桶补齐，751 个 ID 会发 800 个参数
information_blocks.visual_idea: 队列被塞进一排宽度不等的桶，多出的空位被补齐的方块填满
悬崖两侧立着两块坡度相反的碑，一侧沉重迟滞，一侧轻快

information_blocks.source_anchor: 越过 2,098 后 EF 改用单个 JSON 参数 + OPENJSON，不再抛异常
information_blocks.visual_idea: 悬崖之后道路收窄成一条光滑的单参数管道，队列顺畅滑出

main_metaphor: 参数悬崖：队伍在默认翻译下越挤越慢，跨过边界线反而顺畅，因为整队被压成了一个参数
primary_subject: 一支由方块组成的 ID 队列与它所处的悬崖地形
subject_action: 队列沿斜坡推进，在边界线前后发生拥挤与收窄的对比
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: black-and-white printmaking look, carved textures, bold shadows, high contrast, poster-like but no title text
selected_style_reason: 用户未指定风格，本篇从风格池随机选中
style_safety_note: 清单风格为泛类型描述，不涉及品牌、工作室或艺术家复刻
draft_goal: 验证「队列拥堵 → 边界线 → 收窄成单管道」这条摘要弧线是否一眼可读，主焦点是否落在边界线两侧的对比上
revision_targets: 悬崖与单管道的对比是否清楚
中文标签与数字是否清晰可辨
版画纹理是否压过主体
final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: a hidden performance cliff in EF Core 10's default translation of large Contains lists, sitting just below a hard parameter ceiling. The reader should quickly feel that a queue of IDs gets slower and slower, then suddenly flows faster the moment it crosses a boundary line.

Summary angle: a dense column of ID blocks crowds into a bottleneck on a slope, reaches a marked boundary line, and beyond that line the road narrows into one smooth single pipe that flows freely.
Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- problem: a dense queue of small ID blocks jams into a congested slow stretch; visible label 慢速区间
- mechanism: the queue is pressed into a row of buckets and empty padding blocks fill the gaps; visible label 分桶补齐
- evidence: two tall carved slabs stand on either side of the boundary line, one heavy and stalled, one light and fast; visible labels 2098 and 2099
- takeaway (no label): beyond the boundary line the road narrows into a single smooth pipe and the blocks slide through easily

Main metaphor: a parameter cliff - the queue is slowest right before the boundary, and crossing it compresses the whole queue into a single parameter that moves faster.
Subject: a column of carved ID blocks marching along a sloped terrain toward a marked boundary line.
Composition/framing: diagonal advance from lower left to upper right, with the boundary line as the dominant diagonal edge and the single pipe as the resolution at the top right. Wide, legible, one clear focal point.
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: black-and-white printmaking look, carved textures, bold shadows, high contrast, poster-like but no title text. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: ink black, paper white, grey halftone lines, with one restrained vermilion accent used only on the boundary line.
Visible text policy: allow only these 4 short items, each on one small carved chip: 慢速区间, 分桶补齐, 2098, 2099. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no code text, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake terminal output.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: English slogans, fake terminal output, fabricated axes or charts, neon colors, meaningless code rain, floating chips, generic robots, dense HUD overlays.
